messages.subject: Shiny : Variable height of renderplot
parts:
Hello !

I would like to take the height of my plot reactive because sometimes I have to draw just one graph and sometimes two or three graphs. Here my code :

        output$myplot<-renderPlot({
    
        plot_to_draw <- data[data$code==input$code,"River_name"]

        plot(plot_to_draw)  
                              
        number_of_plot <- length(plot_to_draw)

        },height = 500*number_of_plot)

But shiny reads the height of the plot just one time so that it's not reactive.
Thank you for your answers !

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Shiny : Variable height of renderplot
parts: Set the height argument there (currently 500*number_of_plot) to a function instead. However you'll also need to make plot_to_draw a reactive expression outside the renderPlot block so you can get to it from the height function too.
